inspiration.source_location: docs/fix-duplicate-raws.sql: correlated UPDATE with JSON_TABLE and JSON_ARRAYAGG
inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL update rewrites a JSON array through a correlated JSON_TABLE expansion and JSON_ARRAYAGG, removing stale members only from rows that contain a stale identifier.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an archive-document cleanup. A correlated update removes retired raw IDs from JSON arrays, preserves array order through aggregate ordering, skips one-element and unaffected documents, and leaves a document unchanged when no retired ID is present.

fixture_notes: Document 1101 loses retired raw ID 42 while retaining 41 and 43; document 1102 is skipped because it has one element; document 1103 has no retired ID; document 1104 has only active IDs.
determinism_notes: Document IDs, JSON arrays, retired IDs, JSON_TABLE paths, aggregate ordering, predicates, and final ordering are fixed; the fixture has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE archive_documents (document_id INT PRIMARY KEY, raw_id_list JSON NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE retired_raw_ids (raw_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY)

steps.sql: UPDATE archive_documents AS d SET raw_id_list = (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(jt.raw_id ORDER BY jt.raw_id) FROM JSON_TABLE(d.raw_id_list, '$[*]' COLUMNS (raw_id BIGINT PATH '$')) AS jt WHERE jt.raw_id NOT IN (SELECT r.raw_id FROM retired_raw_ids AS r)) WHERE JSON_LENGTH(d.raw_id_list) > 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retired_raw_ids AS r WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(d.raw_id_list, CAST(r.raw_id AS CHAR), '$'))

checks.sql: SELECT document_id, raw_id_list FROM archive_documents ORDER BY document_id
